description: Per Decision 3 in the locked plan, the schema-version contract is meant to be a shared package between this initiative and `execute/gct-pending-ai-provenance-hardening` (currently on a different branch). Coordinate field names + schema-version constant location with that item before persisting `runOutcome` / `state` / `conversationId` / `costUsd` end-to-end. Until this lands, the wire-level fields added in Phases 1–2 are not persisted and readers see empty values.
name: sandbox-provenance-schema-version-shared-package
